entries.title: Psalms 78:1
segments: ¶<<An instruction. Of Asaph.>> Give ear, O my people, to my law; incline your ears to the words of my mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 78:2
segments: I will open my mouth in a parable; I will utter riddles from of old,

entries.title: Psalms 78:3
segments: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us:

entries.title: Psalms 78:4
segments: We will not hide [them] from their sons, shewing forth to the generation to come the praises of Jehovah, and his strength, and his marvellous works which he hath done.

entries.title: Psalms 78:5
segments: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;

entries.title: Psalms 78:6
segments: That the generation to come might know [them], the children that should be born; that they might rise up and tell [them] to their children,

entries.title: Psalms 78:7
segments: And that they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of *God, but observe his commandments;

entries.title: Psalms 78:8
segments: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that prepared not their heart, and whose spirit was not stedfast with *God.

entries.title: Psalms 78:9
segments: ¶The sons of Ephraim, armed bowmen, turned back in the day of battle.

entries.title: Psalms 78:10
segments: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law;

entries.title: Psalms 78:11
segments: And forgot his doings, and his marvellous works which he had shewn them.

entries.title: Psalms 78:12
segments: In the sight of their fathers had he done wonders, in the land of Egypt, the field of Zoan.

entries.title: Psalms 78:13
segments: He clave the sea, and caused them to pass through; and made the waters to stand as a heap;

entries.title: Psalms 78:14
segments: And he led them with a cloud in the daytime, and all the night with the light of fire.

entries.title: Psalms 78:15
segments: He clave rocks in the wilderness, and gave [them] drink as out of the depths, abundantly;

entries.title: Psalms 78:16
segments: And he brought streams out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

entries.title: Psalms 78:17
segments: Yet they still went on sinning against him, provoking the Most High in the desert;

entries.title: Psalms 78:18
segments: And they tempted *God in their heart, by asking meat for their lust;

entries.title: Psalms 78:19
segments: And they spoke against God: they said, Is *God able to prepare a table in the wilderness?

entries.title: Psalms 78:20
segments: Behold, he smote the rock, and waters gushed out, and streams overflowed; is he able to give bread also, or provide flesh for his people?

entries.title: Psalms 78:21
segments: Therefore Jehovah heard, and was wroth; and fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also went up against Israel:

entries.title: Psalms 78:22
segments: Because they believed not in God, and confided not in his salvation;

entries.title: Psalms 78:23
segments: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and had opened the doors of the heavens,

entries.title: Psalms 78:24
segments: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them the corn of the heavens.

entries.title: Psalms 78:25
segments: Man did eat the bread of the mighty; he sent them provision to the full.

entries.title: Psalms 78:26
segments: He caused the east wind to rise in the heavens, and by his strength he brought the south wind;

entries.title: Psalms 78:27
segments: And he rained flesh upon them as dust, and feathered fowl as the sand of the seas,

entries.title: Psalms 78:28
segments: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations:

entries.title: Psalms 78:29
segments: And they did eat, and were well filled; for that they lusted after, he brought to them.

entries.title: Psalms 78:30
segments: They were not alienated from their lust, their meat was yet in their mouths,

entries.title: Psalms 78:31
segments: When the anger of God went up against them; and he slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 78:32
segments: For all this, they sinned still, and believed not in his marvellous works;

entries.title: Psalms 78:33
segments: And he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror.

entries.title: Psalms 78:34
segments: When he slew them, then they sought him, and returned and sought early after *God;

entries.title: Psalms 78:35
segments: And they remembered that God was their rock, and *God, the Most High, their redeemer.

entries.title: Psalms 78:36
segments: But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied unto him with their tongue;

entries.title: Psalms 78:37
segments: For their heart was not firm toward him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.

entries.title: Psalms 78:38
segments: But he was merciful: he forgave the iniquity, and destroyed [them] not; but many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his fury:

entries.title: Psalms 78:39
segments: And he remembered that they were flesh, a breath that passeth away and cometh not again.

entries.title: Psalms 78:40
segments: ¶How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert!

entries.title: Psalms 78:41
segments: And they turned again and tempted *God, and grieved the Holy One of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 78:42
segments: They remembered not his hand, the day when he delivered them from the oppressor,

entries.title: Psalms 78:43
segments: How he set his signs in Egypt, and his miracles in the field of Zoan;

entries.title: Psalms 78:44
segments: And turned their rivers into blood, and their streams, that they could not drink;

entries.title: Psalms 78:45
segments: He sent dog-flies among them, which devoured them, and frogs, which destroyed them;

entries.title: Psalms 78:46
segments: And he gave their increase unto the caterpillar, and their labour unto the locust;

entries.title: Psalms 78:47
segments: He killed their vines with hail, and their sycamore trees with hail-stones;

entries.title: Psalms 78:48
segments: And he delivered up their cattle to the hail, and their flocks to thunderbolts.

entries.title: Psalms 78:49
segments: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and distress, --a mission of angels of woes.

entries.title: Psalms 78:50
segments: He made a way for his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;

entries.title: Psalms 78:51
segments: And he smote all the firstborn in Egypt, the first-fruits of their vigour in the tents of Ham.

entries.title: Psalms 78:52
segments: And he made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock;

entries.title: Psalms 78:53
segments: And he led them safely, so that they were without fear; and the sea covered their enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 78:54
segments: And he brought them to his holy border, this mountain, which his right hand purchased;

entries.title: Psalms 78:55
segments: And he drove out the nations before them, and allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

entries.title: Psalms 78:56
segments: But they tempted and provoked God, the Most High, and kept not his testimonies,

entries.title: Psalms 78:57
segments: And they drew back and dealt treacherously like their fathers: they turned like a deceitful bow.

entries.title: Psalms 78:58
segments: And they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.

entries.title: Psalms 78:59
segments: God heard, and was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:

entries.title: Psalms 78:60
segments: And he forsook the tabernacle at Shiloh, the tent where he had dwelt among men,

entries.title: Psalms 78:61
segments: And gave his strength into captivity, and his glory into the hand of the oppressor;

entries.title: Psalms 78:62
segments: And delivered up his people unto the sword, and was very wroth with his inheritance:

entries.title: Psalms 78:63
segments: The fire consumed their young men, and their maidens were not praised in [nuptial] song;

entries.title: Psalms 78:64
segments: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows made no lamentation.

entries.title: Psalms 78:65
segments: Then the Lord awoke as one out of sleep, like a mighty man that shouteth aloud by reason of wine;

entries.title: Psalms 78:66
segments: And he smote his adversaries in the hinder part, and put them to everlasting reproach.

entries.title: Psalms 78:67
segments: And he rejected the tent of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim,

entries.title: Psalms 78:68
segments: But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved;

entries.title: Psalms 78:69
segments: And he built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he hath founded for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 78:70
segments: And he chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:

entries.title: Psalms 78:71
segments: From following the suckling-ewes, he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.

entries.title: Psalms 78:72
segments: And he fed them according to the integrity of his heart, and led them by the skilfulness of his hands.
